body: Plan a realistic week in 10 minutes. The Claude prompt that tells you what to drop.

Most planning makes your list longer. This one makes it honest.
Give Claude your commitments, your to-do list and your real free hours, then ask it what to drop.
Add when you think best and it puts deep work in those hours.

Save this one for Sunday. Follow @manrajtalks for practical Claude tips you can use the same day.
